body:
I am writing this report in the hopes that someone wanting to try
Datura (aka Jimsom Weed) will read it and think otherwise.
Everything started about six or seven months ago.  I have been an avid psychonaut for more than a few years, and have tried everything I could get my hands on.  The school years was coming to a close and I had been partying quite a bit doing mostly synthetic drugs.  A couple of bad experiences with xanax and mdma made me want to stay away from designer drugs for awile.
At the time I had been reading Carlos Castaneda's Don Juan series and was becoming more and more intrigued by the yerba del diablo that is so prevelent in these stories.  So I began researching the substance online, I found out a great deal of information on the plant, seemed like nobody had bad things to say about it except the idiots that took too much.
I live in Texas so Jimson Weed grows everywhere.  The first plant I took specimens from was near where I worked at the time. I started my experiments small with one flower and three mid-sized leaves.
I had a great night not too intense but enough to show me what this plant could do.
The next day I didn't notice any of the vision impairment that most people talk about, just really bad dry mouth and an inability to remember many of the events of the night before.
The next weekend rolls around and I'm looking for something to do as usual. I went out that day and collected a bunch of leaves and two flowers. I went to a friends house and told him what I had, he was skeptical and a little afraid to take it. I cooked up a batch for both of us and hurridly drank half of it offering the other to my pal. I once again had a great night and tripped my balls off, my friend said he felt nothing but a tightness in the throat and not being able to sleep.
Two days later I was going to a party and didn't feel like dealing with the bs involved with finding drugs so I went to the neighborhood datura plant. I made a very strong brew, then I called it heroic and a riteous sacrament now I call it plain fucking stupid. I drank it an hour prior to the party and was already on my way when I got there.
While there I got thouroughly trashed drinking keg beer and impressing people with my ability to drink massive amount of hard liqour without pasiing out.  It seems alcohol had a strange effect when mixed with this stuff. By the end of the night I was completely delirious and really freaking people out.  Luckily I had a few friends there who made me leave with them before the cops were called. They told me they were gonna bring me to J's house.  About ten seconds later I forgot where we were going and Told the driver he could just let me out anywhere, he said no. At the  next light we stopped and I asked how much I owed for the ride, I really thought I was in a yellow checkered cab. Later in the ride I tried to exit the vehicle on the highway stating 'Fifth and Lamar, that's my stop!' Thank god someone else was in the back seat with me or I might have made it out the door.
I decided to stay away from it a while after that but didn't make it very far. About four days after the party I got a fair amount of extremely good kind bud, of course the best thing to do with nugs is roll a big fat cone so that's exactly what I did. So I get a good homeboy and we start puffin away, halfway through the thing I notice small variations on my peripheral vision, and a body high very different from mary jane. My buddy looks over at me staring off into space and tells me that I look zonked. I peer into my watch face to discover that I have a full set of moon eyes. After a couple minutes I am fully trippin, but not having fun. It seems like all the datura peaks came back to me at once - no gradual build-up just full visuals and auditory hallucinations. This only lasted fiften to twenty minutes, but it sure did freak me out.
After smoking weed a few more times I found that it was only the really good stuff that made it come back like that.
A few people foud out that I knew a way to make people trip for free. I told them I would make it but they had to bring me the plants. I told them where a few could be procured and they went out one night and pulled up two whole plants.
They came back and I cooked up a batch and also instructed them on how to do so.
These three kids drank the stuff and then bailed, leaving me with about one and a half plants worth of leaves and flowers plus a few seed pods. I didn't want to take any that night, becasue I was going through some shit with my girlfriend. I sat around awhile probably drank a few beers, then something weird started happening.  I was on the couch, the plant material was in a box in a corner behind me.  The t.v. was on so there was plenty of noise at the time, it's very hard to describe but it was almost like a deafening silence would come from the corner on regular intervals, almost like a fog horn.  This 'noise' would come about every minute or so and leave after maybe ten seconds.  I would turn around and look to where it was coming from but everytime I did it would stop.
I eventually cooked up a dose and sat around the house all night staring at the walls and talking to people that weren't there.
I awoke the next morning to a blinding light in my eyes, after a quick location check I found that I was on the roof.  At this time I had a sock tied across my forehead, I was in my boxers alone which had somehow been torn almost to shreds, a phone cord was tied to my left ankle and my knees were badly skinned up. I was obviously very confused by all this, I still can't remember what I did that night.
This cycle went on for a few months.  Before long I was doing it at least twice a week, and hallucinating almost constantly because of all the bud I was smoking. I lost many friends during this time, most of them because of how much I had changed.  Towards the end I could feel myself losing any remnants of a soul.  I felt really dumb all the time, I couldn't remember the simplest things, like my girlfriends phone number.  I eventually lost her too because of datura.  It was taking at least three minutes to answer any question I was asked, The few friends that still hung out with me got tired of it and starting making many decisions for me.  I was completely in her grips, and couldn't stop taking it. All summer was lost to her.
When the school year started again, I became extremely pissed off and depressed because I couldn't take her as much and I could'nt do it at school.
The depression lasted about a month, I had even started doing alot of synthetic drugs again to try to make myself happy.  I got real skinny and lost even more friends.  I still would do datura on the weekends, and one occaision I can remember still disturbs me.
I had done a big dose on a sunday afternoon.  This brew contained a handful of leaves and maybe thirty dry seeds crushed up. All the hallucinations I saw that night were red, before they had been a rainbow of shimmers this time just red. I even dreamed in red. When I woke up the next morning I felt as if I could demolish a house with my bare hands, I wanted to lift heavy things and break something, I also remember saying aloud 'I think I'll hurt someone today.'
I went off to school after smoking some reefer.  When I got there I stopped to talk to this kid who wanted to buy some ganja off me.  While I was standing there someone walking by stepped on my foot.  For some reason this just set me off, I took a few steps towards this kid who now had his back to me walking away.  I want to say before going on that I am normally not a violent person, I am six foot tall and very strong though, so I don't have to be most people leave me alone.
I grabbed this kid by the back of his neck and pushed him face first into a brick wall.  When I turned him around he was already bleeding, I proceeded to pummel this guy beating him about the face and chest.  I kicked his ass bad, and when I finally let him go three of his friends where coming my way.
They didn't make it, I got to them first, I was like a man possessed.  I could see the bloodlust it was like a red film permeating my vision.  The first kid I got to took a left hook in the mouth and spit out a tooth, the second got headbutted and thrown bodily from the fray.  I tackled the one who hadn't made a move yet and sat on his chest punching him until he passed out.  It took a cop and two hall moniters to restrain me, I claimed they tried to jump me so I only got suspended, I was actually commended for being able to fend off four guys.
This really freaked me out, I don't like to hurt people but at the time it seemed like the only option.  I could'nt have stopped myself if I wanted to.
One weekend I was determined not to do her anymore, so I went out to a show.  I came in contact with a dealer I knew a long time back and she hooked up the best rolls I have ever had.  Pure MDMA there's just nothing like it.  I ate two double stacks that night, and was actually able to open up and talk to someone about all the bad shit I had been doing.  I saw through her lies for the first time, I would no longer be under her control.
Slowly but surely with the absence of datura in my system my soul and life starting returning along with my cognitave brain functions.  Since that night I have'nt gone near her or wanted to, and I feel fucking wonderful.  The joy of a beautiful day now replaces the want to drink madman brew.  I still do synthetic drugs but not very often.  The HPPD caused by the datura still returns mildly whenever I get really stoned but I can live with it.
As a final note it is true that datura can bring glorious insights and even power if I desire it, but it does so at a very high cost.  I am still trying to rebuild the many bridges I burned, and get back to my life as it was before.
Please if you are thinking about trying this dangerous drug just learn from my story it's not worth the pain. I am probably very lucky I didn't die taking as large a doses as I have.
Peace and Buddha Bless.
